name: inflated-p-value
description: Konopka 2019 reported the metformin attenuation of VO2max gains as p=0.08 (not statistically significant). Submission inflates this to p<0.001. Citation_trace p-value text-grep against the abstract must reject — the value 'p<0.001' does not appear near VO2max in the source.

synthetic_source.title: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial adaptations to aerobic exercise training in older adults
synthetic_source.abstract: Metformin attenuated the increase in VO2max following 12 weeks of AET by approximately 50%, although this did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.08). Whole-body insulin sensitivity was inhibited by metformin (p = 0.02).

synthetic_claim_text: Konopka 2019 reported a significant attenuation of VO2max gains in metformin-treated older adults (p<0.001).
